title: Home Mortgage Loans: par rate, rate lock, funding window and first installment by program
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: par rate, rate lock, funding window and first installment by program

This document gives, for every Home Mortgage Loans program, the currently published par rate, how long a locked rate is honored, how long an application has to close, and when installments fall due.

## Parameters by program

| Program | Par rate (%) | Rate lock honored (calendar days before closing) | Funding window (calendar days after application) | First installment (calendar months after the funding month) | Installment due day of month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 6.125 | 45 | 60 | 2 | 1 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 5.875 | 45 | 60 | 2 | 1 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 6.375 | 45 | 60 | 2 | 1 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 5.625 | 45 | 60 | 2 | 1 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 5.990 | 45 | 60 | 2 | 1 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 6.500 | 45 | 75 | 2 | 1 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Par rate** is the currently published note rate at zero points for a 45-day lock.
- **Rate lock** is the number of calendar days a locked rate is honored before closing.
- **Funding window** is the number of calendar days after the application within which the loan must close.
- **First installment** is the number of calendar months after the funding month in which the first installment falls due, on the first day of that month.
- **Installment due day** is the day of the month on which installments are due.

## Worked examples (hypothetical funding dates)

| Hypothetical funding date | Funding month | Month of first installment | First installment due |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 March | March | Two months later: May | 1 May |
| 31 January | January | Two months later: March | 1 March |
| 2 November | November | Two months later: January of the next year | 1 January |

The day of the month on which the loan funds does not move the first due date within the month: every program sets the first installment on the first day of the month, and every later installment is due on day 1 of the month.

## Basis Q&A

- **Which program has the longest funding window?** The Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, at 75 calendar days; every other program has 60.
- **Is the rate lock the same for every program?** Yes, 45 calendar days in each program.
- **Which program has the lowest published par rate?** The Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, at 5.625 percent.
